text: 24 hours after receipt of item, we are happy with the amount of ice made. The noise from the machine is not significant. We will update this post over time.

This is an awesome machine. It makes ice relentlessly as long as you empty the tray a few times a day and keep filling the reservoir with water.
We use a lot of ice (10-15 conventional trays per day) and this thing keeps up. Ice is a nice size also.
My wife loves it as she was mainly the one constantly filling and emptying ice cube trays before. (Fridge ice-maker is caput and never worked that well anyhow). Now we are inundated with ice!
We dump the ice in our freezer ice maker compartment. Be aware that it will probably stick together when you do this...but it's easy enough to break it back up after a few minutes of a "re-freeze". A couple light taps with a meat tenderizing hammer thingy does well. If this sounds like a lot of work, it's truly much easier than our old tray method.
Alsome
The cubes aren't what I expected but will do quite well. The amount of ice this unit produces is amazing.  Great deal.

Took my new ice maker out of the box, followed the instructions and had ice just as expected. Worked fast and had ice in less than 10 minutes after waiting the 30 minutes in standby mode. I did dump the first three baskets of ice although the directions don't say to do this I have always done it even with a new fridge. Will be using the Della ice maker on the RV and for parties and family gatherings since my very expensive refrigerator can't keep up with our demand for ice!
I have only had it for 2 days but it has performed incredibly. It makes 10 cubes about every 6 minutes. It is pretty quiet. If it continues to perform at this level it is a best buy for me.
Had to replace mine, it died a very slow death, Love my Della works great very fast and love the larger ice cubes.

The old story--everything is fine until it isn't. Seller said go away after a problem at 6 mos. Couldn't provide a phone # for della! Phone for della in owners manual goes to seller but they don't know why! FISHY OUTFIT. Buy at your own risk!
Works good for the two of us.  Excellent for making drinks. Not enough for an ice chest. If you plan ahead and have a freezer the ice can be made in large quantities and stored for large use.

Nice looking machine. Works well. The booklet refers to the operation manual which would be very helpful but was not in the box. It's a little slower than I had expected and, because of lack of manual I have no idea how to make the bullet ice smaller or larger. All in all, the machine does it's job.

This portable ice maker is sleek. It works as describe.  But as  someone mentioned, the ice cannot be stored in it.  This is not a problem for me, I bag the ice and put it in the freezer if I'm not using it immediately.  If you need lots of ice you have to plan ahead.
The ice maker in our fridge broke.We needed ice the Della does a great job.We don't use it as much now that we have a new fridge but it's there if we need extra ice.Very happy

(Actually I'd do 4.5 stars but ...)  This is a great ice make and I would buy it again.  When I built my kitchen, I had a choice between wine cooler or ice maker.  Well....my fridge had an ice maker so the wine cooler won.  2 years later I really needed more ice than my fridge makes (worse ice maker EVER for a fridge but I digress....).  Summer months are brutal around here, we have 4 ppl making smoothies, and I entertain every Monday in my home, not to mention host Sun dinner for my family and my kids' boy/girl friends.  I've been really happy with this ice maker.  It works like a charm!!!  Highly recommend it.  However, my complaints are:  I tried keeping it in my pantry to avoid using up my counter space but could not do so because it generates too much heat so on the counter top it stays, and 2) it's noisy and beeps alot so you HAVE to turn it off during the night or you will hear it will annoyingly wake you up.  Otherwise, works like a charm.
It works okay, but it is a noisy machine.  I have to drain it at least once a week and leave it unplugged for awhile  It is very moody
Great product

I love it!  I don't have a refrigerator with an ice maker.  I use filtered water and just fill the dispenser and don't worry about it.  It recycles the ice and makes small to medium-sized cubes that are hollowed out, crunchable.  If you like to crunch ice, you will like this.  Makes drinks incredibly cold.  Does not make a lot of ice cubes--just enough for 2 or 3 glasses at a time, but then keeps refilling itself.  Comes with a little scoop.  You just lift the lid and take out your ice.  Might be nice on a bar too.  I use it for orange juice and fruit drinks.

Simple to use and makes ice quickly. Each batch of ice is small but because it makes each batch fast, you'll get plenty of ice in an hour or two.
--------------------
Update: after three months of use, usually running for several hours about twice a week, my ice maker stopped working today. In addition, out of 9 prongs that make ice, only 5 have made ice for the past few weeks. This problem started with the back left prong not making ice, then slowly the next ones stopped working over time until today only 4 made ice in two cycles when the ICE FULL light came on and it stopped. The ice was nowhere near full. I posted a question on Della's 'Contact Us' web site over a week ago and they never responded although their Contact Us page states "All emails will be responded to within 12 hours".

I wasn't sure what to expect, but it by far
Surpassed my expectations. It is easy to use and just makes plenty of ice. If any time in the future, I need a new one this will be it. I'm very happy.

This ice maker worked great for about 60 days and it is now not working. The machine was never moved, powered with a power strip to prevent surges, and it will not make ice. We unplugged it, hit reset, drained it, and nothing. It lights up but will not produce. Waste of money.  I am not sure if I can even return it. That is 120 bucks possibly lost.
Works well. Ice cubes are a little watery. Overall a good buy
This was a gift which recipient says works very well and makes as much ice as description says.  Good value.
A little larger than what I expected for a counter top, but otherwise very efficient.

this makes ice on a continuous basis, quickly and efficiently.  as long as you keep water in it- it goes! I was concerned about everyone saying that this was not a place to store ice- and it isn't really, but it fills so quickly that I use it when needed, turn it off and turn on again later or the next day.  if I need a larger amount, it is just a matter of dumping in a container for the freezer, and adding more when the next batch comes out. a good investment, and it sure beats paying $400 every time my icemaker has a headache.

Excellent service since I have had it.  I turn it on and bag up several bags and place in the freezer.  I used them as needed and when gone I freeze some more with "Della".  It is great and I hope it will last me a couple of years.

So far, so good with this icemaker.  It arrived quickly, I plugged it in and waited 30 minutes as the instructions indicated, then poured in the water and turned it on.  It produced ice very quickly, in fact the longer it ran the quicker it seemed to produce the ice.  May have had something to do with the ice accumulating in the bin making the water underneath colder.  The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars was that I would rather the ice be a little harder when first produced.  But I dump it into a tray in my freezer and it works very well.
I love my ice on demand!!!! Takes about five mins to make 1 batch which is about 8 cubes!
Love it!
This baby works great!  About 3 to 4 dozen bullet cubes per hour.

It looks nice. It turns water into ice. We liked it for a while.

When it gets full, it beeps 8 times. Loud, annoying beeps. Some ice melts, the level drops, it beeps once and makes more ice, then beeps 8 times again. All day. It says the beeps are to let you know it's full, so you can empty it. I don't plan to empty it. We left our Igloo ice maker turned on 24/7, leaving the ice in it.

The first day we had it, it didn't seem to know that it was full. It kept making ice. The ice piled up in front of the tray until it couldn't tip to empty itself. It kept pumping water into the tray and freezing it until it was a big solid block. We had to turn the machine off and wait for the block to melt. I thought it was a fluke. It happened again the next day.

We returned it and ordered a different brand. One that reviewers say is quiet.

"The little engine that can!"
Great machine!
It works great and it's a well made machine; but it doesn't make enough ice fast enough to warrant having another appliance on top of my counter.

We were excited to be given this ice maker for a wedding gift earlier this year. Unfortunately, upon receiving the unit and proceeding to set it up according to the directions, the ice maker kept throwing an "add water" error, even though it was full of water. After trying multiple times, and running through the very basic troubleshooting steps in the instruction manual, I contacted DELLA USA/RGE Direct and was asked for a video of the issue. They promptly shipped me a new unit, which was wonderful, but indicated to me that this is a common issue with these machines. Well, guess what? The replacement ice maker showed up and had the EXACT SAME ISSUE! After letting it sit for a few days, it finally started to work. Then after a few cycles, it unsurprisingly started to throw the "add water" error again. This continued intermittently until the unit completely failed a couple of weeks later. I contacted DELLA USA/RGE Direct again and after emailing and calling twice, they finally emailed me back saying they would simply send me a refund... That didn't help us, since they were simply refunding the friend that gave us the ice maker as a gift in the first place!

I finally gave up and purchased the NewAir AI-100S icemaker [[ASIN:B000N6302Q NewAir AI-100S 28-Pound Portable Ice Maker, Silver]]
This is a fantastic unit, and works absolutely perfectly. It's slightly larger than the Della, but has better functionality with three cube size options, a larger h

This is a great little ice maker, but don't expect it to last more than 9-10 months.  This is my second one.  The first one just died after about 10 months, but the manufacturer replaced it.  I had to go about a month without it, waiting for the replacement.  Now, 9 months into my second one, the same thing has happened.  It just stopped working. It turns on and goes through all of it's beeps (which are loud and annoying, by the way), but it does not draw water into the freezing mechanism and no longer makes ice.  I will not be buying another Della.  Perhaps it would be worth spending more, but I am disappointed in ice makers at this point and may just resort to the old fashioned way of making ice.... using ice cube trays.
With in 15 mins had all the Ice I needed. Great for the Toy Hauler.

Worked fine for six months, then stopped. "Add Water" alert comes on and unit stops when there is still water in the reservoir. Replacement unit did the same thing. No reply to message sent to OneBigOutlet, the third party seller.
The ice maker on our refrigerator could not keep up with our family of 5, so I bought this ice make to help. It makes ice fast and we bag it and put it in the freezer to use when we need.
Works as stated with bottled water for clean and smell free ice.

This was bought as a Christmas present. Daughter loves to paint and draw and was keeping her brushes in a shoe box. This product holds multiple items as you can see in the pictures however I wish it were to swivel/turn so that she may access some of these easier. Just would of been better if it turned. Other than that it's not huge nor small and holds quite a bit of items.
Product was as great as expected.
I love them! no more fingerprints on the handles!
Very nice touch for the holidays.  Got compliments on it.  They do slip around a bit, since the closure with the velcro isn't super tight, but still looked very nice.
Wife was complaining about smudges on the "frige" handles got these for her SHE LOVES ME AGAIN
Pretty neat! Don't' have to worry about finger print on my stainless steel appliances.
Satisfied customer!!
These are just perfect!!

a little too large for my frigidaire stainless steel fridge handles. they end up slipping down like teachers stockings. its hard to hide the velcro area. my door opens up into a brick wall which is why i felt the need to protect my handles. in that regard, they could be a little thicker but they get the job done
covers well. Would like it a bit tighter around the handles, but it works.

I bought the black ones.
It fits fine around the refrigerator handle and the length is fine.
However, the black surface rubs off on the walls, thereby necessitating the wall to be touched up.

These fit our fridge perfect, love the velvety fabric. Read some reviews about them sliding or spinning but they are okay for me on the top vertical handles. The lower horizontal ones apin and I used some of that rubbery stuff that goes under an area rug to prevent sliding or non skid liner for the glass cabinet to grip the fabric and handle. Thin, works perfectly.
I love these they are so soft to the touch. I will definitely recommend these to my friends and family.

Product is wonderful. Works extremely well & you don't have to make sure your hands are free from moisture after washing dishes or grabbing something cold out of the freezer that leaves your fingers moist before using the handles on your fridge/freezer. Wipes clean with a paper towel should you get anything on them. They are washable but I haven't washed mine yet. I ordered 22 inch long ones which cover most of the handle. The grey really blends in nicely with the stainless steel. Now if they could make Stainless steel not leave prints.. we'd be set. The seller is extremely helpful if you need special sizes for your handles.
Look and fit beautifully!!

I bought 2 sets one for oven and refrigerator.  After a month I stopped using and went back to just wiping with a sponge and cleaner; easier than removing, machine washing, drying and putting back on. Maybe for holidays with a lot of folks over I would use, but probably not.

We got a new fridge with the door that opens up against a wall. To protect the fridge and wall we tied a towel around the handle until we found this.  They look and feel really nice.  The velcro holds it together quite well and hasn't "opened" up while opening/closing the fridge doors.
Did not know what to expect but was very pleased with the look. I would recommend.
Excellent product would buy again but probably not for a long time they hold up very well

These are exactly what I was looking for. My kitchen is small, so the handle hits the counter when the door is open. They are thick enough to stop the handle from making scratches in my counter.  I have received many compliments on them already.
love them. They don't slide or show dirt
Keeps the wife happy as i no longer leave my grubby hand marks all over the fridge. The velvet handle covers are well made and looks great. Thanks!
Love these simple black covers.
Oh my i love it..no more fingerprints to my appliances, so velvety soft
very soft material! love it
Great
Love it, color is perfect and looks great in my stainless steel frig
Looks very good
Love these! They arrived faster than i expected. Matches my kitchen well and helps to keep the handles clean!
Got here fast , and worked well.
They fit perfect and are easy to wipe off. Love them
It is slightly bit loose, but does the job...makes the handles alot harder to smudge!
These really help keep fingerprints off the refridgerator behind the handles. They work great. You should buy them!
Looks great on my refrigerator

We bought a black appliances and the door handle always showed finger prints. I found these handle covers here in Amazon and couldn't be happier with them. I bought two sets, one set for the fridge and another set for our double oven. They look great!!!
They work well for our concern. We use them on outer door handles that get hot from the sun.
VERYYYYY GOOOODDDD!!
Everyone should have these. They're awesome
great...no finger prints or food gunk get on handle...was tire wiping down handle several times a day

OMG, so elegant, PERFECT for Christmas time or when you have guests coming over. SOOO pretty!! wish it came with a shorter third one for the microwave. :-( Came sooner than expected too! worth the money!
The other pair I order thru amazon was all black even the velcro. Theven velcro on these are white and can be seen easily.
it was a wrong shade. It was too light
So far so good - they have solved the smudege problem on the shiny door handles on my refridgerator and that makes me happy.  They are worth the purchase if smudges make you crazy!
keeps me from shocking to crap out of myself when i open the door. now i can discharge that static when i touch my wife :P
I love it, good quality
Exactly what we were looking for.

LOVE THIS! HELPED SOOO MUCH TO KEEP DIRT AWAY FROM MY NEW APPLIANCES.
THANK YOU!
Great product and loved the look.
Very good quality.
Great product. Fits great and very sturdy.

they work great.
a little loose for my refrigerator, but looks good.

just as it is in the picture and serves the purpose !

Great product
I have an old frig and my handles are messed up. Until I can find a new refrigerator that fixs where the old one is is perfect for now. Glad I purchased
Very good product.
On time, lots of accessory with camera, easy to carry.

Interesting enough. The day that I purchased my Refrigerator door handle covers. My mom came over and was discussing with me how she wanted to go to the material store to purchase some linen to make covers for her refrigerator.  I must of giggled for 5 minutes.  I told her that she could purchase the handles cheaper then she could probably make them. Especially when it came to quality of material, stitching, Velcro etc.  I told her to wait till I received mine to make her decision.  When mine arrived. I invited her over to look at them.  She was really impressed. She tugged on it.. Ran her hands over the material. Took them on and off.  She was impressed. Especially at how the Grey Stainless steele colour matched perfectly.  I know I'm enjoying it. My husband often goes outside to work and then comes in to get a drink and WHAM, Stains on handles, grease, fingerprints etc. Now I can just take it off throw it in the wash and be done with it. Instead of scrubbing that blame handles for 10 minutes at a time.  Reading this I know it sounds like I'm lazy.... But I don't care, when you work alot of hours. Deducting 10 minutes worth of cleaning from your schedule is a blessing.  I think Ougar8 has started something awesome.  I think it would be neat to see different patterns thrown in.  Maybe even some holiday patterns to spice things up. :P Thankyou!

Very handy and nifty little cover for the handles of the refrigerator. You can get it in three colors but I chose the grey because it blends in a little better. These covered wrap around pretty easily and the Velcro is quite strong.from what I can tell it slips easily by hand but doesnt slip up and down from just sitting on the fridge. I'm a fan.
Love these handle covers.

I got these because my fridge handles are always getting dirty, to the point i get annoyed with it.  These cover perfectly, and make the handles soft.  It is not something I would ever think is necessary, but they are a great item.
It will not stay in place. It slides down after some usage.

I really like the way these door handle covers look on my refrigerator. I have a stainless steel refrigerator and we all know just how easy it is to get finger prints on it. So with these handle covers you are able to prevent finger prints and stains on the door handle. I recommend this item as it give you fridge a new look kind of!
They fit well a d feel comfortable!

On my Whirlpool fridge, these are a little loose and slide around. I ordered them in black, to match my black fridge, the Velcro seams are white and don't stay perfectly flat.

These will probably work on many fridge models, but on mine, there's no way to get them tighter, because of the small width of Velcro seams
Like it, especially when I forgot to get something and my hand are really wet.

Great product! Looks just like the picture and it blends nicely with my fridge. Most importantly, it keeps my handles clean.

Laura Moore
Thanks ☺

Depending on how the handles are made on your appliances, these work beautifully. I live in an apartment and although I have a normal size fridge, the handles are not long or very wide. That worked out okay these though because I cut one of then in half and was able to cover the handle of both fridge and freezer. You can see that in the photos I'm submitting. I was worried about the fabric fraying but, surprisingly, I was able to cut it evenly and it's not frayed or ragged looking in the least. Thank goodness. The handles on the fridge/freezer are slim so this didn't go on a snugly as I would have liked. I don't have kids so that's not as much of a problem as it would be for someone with little ones.

I used the second cover on the oven handle and it fit's much better. For one thing, the oven handle is longer so I didn't need to do any re-sizing. Also, the oven handle is slightly thicker than the fridge/freezer so the cover just works better there.

The $10 I paid is okay for what I got. I would not be happy to pay the higher non-Prime price of $16! No way.

I mainly got these because of the color and the way they dress up my small kitchen. The fact that they keep the handles cleaner is not that big of a deal for someone without kids or messy roommates.
Nicely made
I love this!
Skips a little bit too much but works great to stop any marks on the stainless steel handles.

These are very long so unless you have handles like the ones pictured you might want to order the ones that are made for microwaves. I ended up using one of  the microwave  ones and it works perfect. It is a super idea to help keep handles clean. I will be washing them with my dishtowels.
this is a good product with nice website and mobile apps.  Easy to install.  It wont reach quite as far as I need so now I need to buy a booster, but otherwise quite pleased with it.

In addition to the server issues that other buyers complain about, the setup instructions were nearly useless.  The company says that there is additional setup information on the website, including videos.  I wasn't able to find anything.  I muddled through and was able to figure things out after several days.  Now, due to the server issue I'm only able to view my temperature information by logging onto the website.  No information is available with the app, which means I can't monitor the temperature except by computer, there are no alarms available since these work through the app.
Works pretty good at glitches a little bit sometimes
The iPhone app isn't so great. Range is limited.

So far I have enjoyed this product. I like having the ability to track the temperature in my house anywhere I am. I have had no issues quickly setting the product up and the range so far has been good. I have had two issues though. First the Iphone app doesn't usually work. I have had it work a couple of times but it is unreliable. My second issue is you can't tell what unit is what. It comes with three sensors which pretty much automatically connect to the unit but they aren't labeled so you have to figure out which sensor is 1, 2 and 3.

I purchase the unit to monitor temperatures in my office, store room and outside. Within three days one of the three sensors failed, within a  week the IOS system on my apple said unable to get sensor data. Forbidden! It worked fine for the first week and then nothing but trouble. Fortunately I had a old sensor and somehow it linked to that! So the only way I can get my data is on my laptop. Does not seem worth it for the trouble it has caused. Will consider returning in a few days unless it corrects its mess! I have researched the info from other user review on my iphone app and it says to delete their HQ data which I do not want anyway. That seems to have been the main problem. Also after installing the program on your phone you will need to install and reinstall a few times before it really works properly. If the company would read the reviews they might see that others have the same problems and try to fix it before they ship it out to customers!

Some nice features but when humidity shows under 50% from all three sensors and local weather says 72% then this product will not serve its intended purpose.  Also, one sensor indicated temperature 4 degrees F below the other two. Will return item.

We installed these units in our food warehouse to eliminated the need walk to each unit and record cooling temperatures.  But we spent a considerable chunk of money in running wires to have the bridges within proximity of the sensors.  We found that 100 feet of proximity worked best for our needs.

I would give it 5* if not the faulty app.
Except this it working fine. Installation could be better.
Et the end because the alert setting wasn't ok and the app didnt gave warning that the connection lost it didn't deliver.
Just after I'v looked on the device through normal browser I learned to late that there is a problem. So if you don't use the app it's OK

One star for the good customer service. 0 stars for the product. Bought this back in September and even after being sent a replacement, it still does not work as advertised. For the last week, the indoor monitor has been telling me its 20 degrees warmer outside than it actually is. I have a sensor placed 100 feet away in a seedling shed, and it hardly ever reads it.

I would call them again, probably for the 4th time, but I am done wasting time on a product that I know just does not work as well as they say it does. I don't like leaving negative review but I feel that it was warrented this time because I would have never bought it if I knew it wasn't capable of reading less than 100 ft away.

Using this with the 5-in-1 weather station, works great top upload to AcuRite and underground. Have had it a few months without the slightest problems. I also use the AcuRite app on my iPhone, works very well. Keep in mind this thing can only connect to three of AcuRite's devices, so one of the supplied thermometers cannot be used by me since I already had the 5-in-1. However, this was cheaper than buying two thermometer sensors and the base unit separately.

It's a little tough to set up - and the UI is not entirely intuitive on the iPhone app - but it works as designed.  I'm running three sensors that are 1 -2 floors away from the base unit and it all works fine.  It's great to be able to monitor these temperatures from an iPhone from wherever I am home or remote.  It'll alert you if it loses connectivity.  I couldn't find where you can set temp limits by sensor (or at all) to send you an alert (that would be great).  You'll need a good, stable wifi.  If you have that - this works as advertised.
Great Item

Being that it's 2016 I would think that something like this would work right out of the box no problem. Boy was I wrong. This took forever to connect and start getting readings, which didn't update properly for about 45 minutes. Awful. We stuck one of the sensors in the refrigerator and it took about 40 minutes for the update a change in temperature not even the correct temperature of the refrigerator. I have yet to talk to technical support, but I have a feeling it's going to be a waste of time. All the other Wireless technology my house works flawlessly with very little interference from the microwave and other conflicting devices. When I do a speed test from the same location as the sensors, I'm getting 30 down and 25 up, so it's not like they can't connect to the receiver. I had the app work once for an hour on my s6.  Then I couldn't get it to reconnect after uninstalling and reinstalling. The web interface works well, but doesn't update well at all.  I will most like return this for a non-wifi triple sensor system and live stream the monitor via an old smart phone on a tripod using Alfred.

I really wanted this to work. It was easy to set up. I had no problem registering at the web site and setting up triggers. It was easy to go view sensor history, etc. on the web site. But triggering of emails and texts did not work. It is supposed to contact you when the temperature range is exceeded.

I reported this and 2 days later got an automated response telling me the problem report was being closed. So I submitted the bug report again. 2 days later it was automatically closed again. I did call and talked to someone in support, who promised me that they would determine the problem and would keep the bug report open.

After another email exchange with tech support a month later, and with no resolution to the lack of triggered alerts, I gave up. But I could still go to the web site daily and check status -- which was great, though not optimal.

Then, I reduced my Time Warner Internet service to a maintenance level (aka "Everyday Low Price") for the season and suddenly everything stopped working. AcuRite pointed at TW as the culprit, claiming insufficient bandwidth. TW claimed that they could ping my modem and I was getting the required 1 Mb of upload speed, but I was no longer there to verify it.

The upshot is that I'd have to pay $50 a month to TW to get more than 1 Mb of upload bandwidth to make this work. I could get a security service for less than that. So the great experiment failed.

I'm now trying the Mar
Have a remote site.  Helps to know that heat is working in winter months when not there.

I received the bridge and sensor bundle and within less than an hour was able to connect to it with the app and from my desktop. I followed some of the suggestions from other reviewers to set the channel on each tower to a different channel (A,B or C). I also created my account at acu-link.com before receiving the item and deleted the factory shared bridge under "follow my friend's bridge".
I had to calibrate 2 of the towers by 1-3 degrees to my thermostats and it looks like it is updating within 5 minutes. I had some trouble connecting to the web site for about 15 minutes after I completed set up. After that, it wasn't an issue. I also tested the email alerts and it worked.
Since I have had this for only a day, I can't comment on the long-term reliability yet, but I wanted to comment on the install process.
The IOS app is pretty good, but the multi tower dashboard is limited to 5 items and it would be nice to have the ability to calibrate from the settings in the app (calibration seems to be only available at the web site).

Initial setup isn't too hard but the instructions are missing key information like the fact that the tower will automatically connects and appears on the website after the bridge is setup.

The website is pretty basic but works and you can see your data there. You have to put batteries in one tower then go online an name it then batteries on the next and name that one and so on to not get the different towers confused.

The app does not work. It simply won't connect to wherever it's supposed to get the data from.

The item itself seems to work with semi accurate results although may be slow to update online. Also, I do not like that you have to register it with a street address, but I do like that the website has graphs of the temperature at different time periods

Edit: about one week in and the humidity sensor on one of the towers is not accurate. registers as 1% when two other types of monitors that are accurate register the humidity at 42%.
They work perfect. Use them in my refrigerator  and freezer.
Love the thermometers.  The website and app are not good.
Product is ok and was easy to set up but range of wireless sensors is disappointing.

Well, I had this item for a few months in my cabin and all was working fine. Then the big upgrade came which they informed everyone well in advance about and I guess it din't go so well for my unit and it quit working. Called Tech Support and got an English speaking person who is in the US and from the US who walked me through one last try to get the unit to work and then said they are replacing it, no more messing around and that was that. They sent the unit no charge and I am back up and running with no issues. This company needs to be commended for their Tech Support and how they stand behind their product. Also note that I have the Android app and it is working well as well as the PC app. Highly recommend the company and the product!!!
Very easy to set up and generally reliable. Used to monitor second home temperatures.  So far so good.

I've had this system for 6 weeks now and continue to be fascinated by how well it is working. One sensor is in a freezer in the basement and another is in the meat keeper in the refrigerator (the third measures room temperature in a bedroom). The receiver is on the second floor at the opposite end of the house from the freezer a couple of feet from my router. The transmissions penetrate the metal freezer and refrigerator walls with little trouble.

Signal loss is infrequent, once every 2 or 3 days for the freezer, approximately weekly for the refrigerator, and corrects itself with no intervention on my part.
